rationale: The frozen corpus currently has 16 family representatives, so exact pairwise scoring requires only 120 comparisons and avoids approximate MinHash variance. A preliminary threshold sweep produced 46 candidate pairs at 0.70, 19 at 0.80, and 0 at 0.90; 0.80 is a review-queue workload choice, not a calibrated duplicate classifier. Every candidate remains pending human adjudication, and no family or split is changed.
